title: Room
description: One room, an axis-aligned box. Indoors it has walls with doorways cut into them. Outdoors set `open`: the perimeter still stops you, but nothing is drawn there, so a street ends in empty space rather than a wall. `blocks` are the solid masses standing inside it (buildings on a street), which you walk around, not through.

floorKit.description: asset-registry id (or kit family tag) for the floor pieces.

wallKit.description: asset-registry id (or kit family tag) for the wall pieces.

inventory.description: Pick-up items available in this room.

open.description: True for open ground (a street, a plaza): the perimeter is a limit you cannot cross, drawn as nothing. Default false, which is a walled room.

blocks.description: Solid volumes standing inside this room: building masses on a street. Nothing walks through one; a door on a block's face leads to the instance inside it.

assetRef.description: Kit piece to face it with. Omitted means a plain mass.
